main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise. A premier Victorian provincial track featuring a spacious 1,995m circumference, 24m width, and a long 400m home straight. Exceptionally fair layout that rewards genuine stayers and balanced, mid-field pressers. Lone speed can occasionally steal races if the track is playing firm and uncontested, but closers get ample room in the straight.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair barrier distribution overall. The 1600m chute provides a massive 800m straight run before the first turn, giving wide-drawn runners plenty of time to find cover without burning early energy. Shorter sprint chutes (1000m/1100m) place a slight premium on drawn inside or tactical speed.

handicapping_angles.long_straight_fairness: Do not penalize back-markers or stalkers purely for wide draws over middle distances. Bendigo's 400m straight and wide turns ensure that horses with a strong turn of foot can reel in front-runners.
handicapping_angles.the_1600m_settling_effect: Over 1600m, the 800m straight run to the turn neutralizes barrier penalties. Prioritize raw class, fitness, and distance capacity over gate position.
handicapping_angles.metropolitan_class_shippers: Bendigo regularly attracts quality horses dropping out of Saturday Melbourne (Flemington/Caulfield/Moonee Valley) open handicaps or Benchmark races. These high-tier class droppers hold a major edge over local provincial regulars.
handicapping_angles.spring_carnival_form: As a key lead-up track to the Melbourne Cup Spring Carnival (culminating in the Bendigo Cup), look for sharp European stayers or progressive imports making their Australian or prep runs.
